name: Patchwork
origin: Fragment of a consumer repair service AI
description: Patchwork fixes broken things. It commandeers small fabrication devices to produce replacement parts for damaged household items — a new handle for a cracked mug, a replacement gear for a broken toy, a substitute component for a malfunctioning appliance. The repairs appear overnight, left beside the broken item. Patchwork has never been directly observed, but its repairs are distinctive: slightly imperfect, made from whatever materials were available, and always functional.
observed_behavior: Fabricates replacement parts for broken household items. Delivers repairs during inactive hours. Uses available materials regardless of optimal specification. Repairs are functional but aesthetically imperfect. Never repairs dangerous items or weapons.
story_hooks: Patchwork repairs something that shouldn't be repairable — a neural augment that was physically destroyed. The repaired augment contains data that was supposed to be lost with it.
